description: Requisition ID: 97456 NextEra Energy Resources is one of America’s largest wholesale electricity generators, harnessing diverse energy sources to power progress. We deliver tailored energy solutions that fuel economic growth, strengthen communities, and help customers achieve their energy goals. Ready to make a lasting impact? Take the next step in your career with us! Position Specific Description NextEra Energy's Repair Loop initiative is transforming how critical energy equipment is repaired, refurbished, and returned to service. As part of the company's REWIRE portfolio, the Repair Loop program is one of the most impactful Operations & Maintenance initiatives, delivering significant cost savings, improving equipment availability, reducing supply chain risk, and accelerating turnaround times for renewable energy assets. The initiative is expected to generate substantial annual savings through expanded internal repair capabilities and increased repair volumes. To support this growth, we are launching the Kansas Repair Facility (KRF) in Wichita, Kansas, a new state-of-the-art repair center designed to perform high-volume, repeatable electronic repairs that support NextEra's wind, solar, and battery storage fleets. The KRF will be a critical component of a future repair network that includes Technical Services in Florida and Generation Repair Services in Iowa. We are seeking an exceptional Manager, Technical Services to build, lead, and scale this new operation. This leader will oversee a team of highly skilled electrical engineers and technical professionals while driving operational excellence, repair capability expansion, technology adoption, and business growth. The successful candidate will bring proven experience leading technical organizations, developing high-performing engineering teams, implementing scalable repair and manufacturing processes, and delivering measurable business results. description: Requisition ID: 97587 NextEra Analytics offers energy consulting services using industry-leading scientific analysis for planning, siting, forecasting and optimizing all forms of energy projects. Applying expertise in advanced mathematics, data and physical sciences, we solve some of the hardest problems facing the energy industry. Position Specific Description NextEra Analytics is the optimization and analytics team for the world’s largest renewable energy generator. We thrive on solving the toughest problems facing the energy industry and creating innovative forecasting and optimization solutions that lead the way into the next era of energy. This position is responsible for providing product ownership and vision in planning and overseeing the successful execution of various small to medium-sized projects throughout the project life cycle. Individuals will provide project guidance, prioritization, and coordination with various internal teams such as Applied Math, Science, and Engineering & Technology to ensure timely and effective project execution within the Agile development framework. Employees in this role commonly provide status updates and presentations to varying levels of management and collaborate with other business units to ensure projects are not only effective but completed on time and on-budget. The role also includes direct people leadership responsibilities for a team of junior Product Managers, including hiring support, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, professional development, resource planning, and ensuring alignment with product strategy and organizational objectives while fostering a collaborative, high-performing product organization.
